title: Inaki Baz Castillo
html:
Iñaki Baz Castillo studied at Universidad del País Vasco, Spain, in area of IP communications.

Registered developer of Kamailio (OpenSER) and very active within community, Inaki has deep knowledge of SIP SIMPLE Presence and XCAP, authored and contributed to other releated projects, such as Kamailio Munin plugin, Ruby SIP Parser and XCAP Client, SIP ALG detector and YASS. He is a passionate Open Source and Open Protocols advocate, speaking about Kamailio (OpenSER) at various events.

Contact: ibc [at] aliax (dot) net
